profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Microsoft
profile.summary: Hi, I’m Alyssa Rivera. I like making things that feel good to use :)

positions.title: SWE Co-Op
positions.description:
Worked on the New Ventures 1 team creating brand new products for Toast. 
Developed in a full-stack environment using Kotlin, Typescript, HTML, CSS.
Performed as a project manager tasks, leading kickoffs, writing documentation, and programing the feature.

positions.title: Explore Intern
positions.description: 12 week internship on an ideation team for Outlook completing project management and software engineer tasks. I conducted user interviews, wrote tech documentation and lead feature kickoffs. I then spent 7 weeks working as a full stack engineer coding in Typescript, HTML, and CSS developing the solution that was designed from my project management research.

positions.title: Programming and Data Visualization Assistant
positions.description: Assisted a professor and a CS graduate student on an in-progress text mining and data visualization project that explores how to track silence in William Shakespeare’s plays using Python

positions.title: Team Member
positions.description:
Week-long challenge where my team designed, modeled, and
prototyped a solution for a client and presented our design at the
symposium.
March 2021 : Designed a reaching and grabbing device for
individuals with quadriplegia, then presented research and design
prototype to our client, Endless Highway.
Sep 2021: Designed an inclusive playground and presented
research and design layout to our client, Endless Highway

positions.title: Fintech Focus Fellow
positions.description:
FinTech Focus is an immersive four-week program sponsored and hosted by a consortium of top-tier financial institutions (Bank of America, Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan Chase, Morgan Stanley, and Wells Fargo) to gain a foundational understanding of the FinTech sector and computer science.

• Built full-stack web applications using the Flask web framework, MongoDB, Python, HTML, and CSS
• Developed and iterated upon prototypes and Minimum Viable Products (MVPs), which culminated in presentations of a final web application

positions.title: Private Tutor
positions.description:
• Privately tutored one high school student and one middle student on science and math
• Math topics included Pre-Algebra, Algebra, Algebra II, and Geometry
• Science topics included Biology, Chemistry, and Environmental Science

positions.title: Assistant Preschool Teacher/ STEM Teacher
positions.description:
• Aided in various classrooms ranging in ages <1 year to 5 years old by conducting projects, crafts, lessons, and playing with the children.
•Created a STEM curriculum aimed towards three to five year olds focused heavily on problem-solving and encouraging curiosity. Would conduct a weekly STEM lesson that would alternate between increasing experimental skills and logical thinking skills

honors.title: Silver Award in the Arts
honors.description: Received a silver award for my piece "Ambiguity", placing the piece in the top 30% of the total 3,570 works submitted.

honors.title: Honorable Mention in the Arts
honors.description: Received an honorable mention for my piece "Please Stop Staring".

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Founded my robotic's team outreach program that won the District and Regional Engineering Inspiration award (2020), qualifying team for the World Championship
• Organized and created a STEM curriculum/program for preschools in Hackettstown, NJ that was implemented at three different schools
• Created a free summer robotics program for middle school students at Hackettstown Public Library, where we taught the fundamentals of robotics using Lego Mindstorm kits
• Helped raise $1500 at annual ARC Carnival through hosting a robotics racing game
• Taught free weekly STEM lessons at Heaven Sent Nursery (2019-20) and bi monthly lessons at Pumpkin Patch Preschool and A2Z Academy of Early Learning
• Garnered funding for team through presenting our outreach program and our team at MARS Inc.

• Helped organize fresh produce from rotten produce donated from farmers at the Rochester Public Market
• Fresh produce was weighed to be donated to local homeless shelters and rotten produce was either composted or donated to local farms as livestock feed

organizations.name: Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers
organizations.description:
Volunteered at SHPE hosted events
Helped organize SHPE events

organizations.name: Society of Women Engineers
organizations.description: Helped plan Social Kate Hour's, events dedicated to uplifting women in engineering and provide an open space for women to collaborate and learn
